just_in.title: Cervical Cancer Cases in India Drop 37% Over a Decade, Driven by Screening and Vaccination Push
just_in.excerpt: Data from India's cancer registries shows a significant decline in cervical cancer incidence rates over the past decade, as opportunistic screening expands and the country rolls out its first nationwide HPV vaccination campaign.
just_in.image_caption: A healthcare worker administers a vaccine. India launched its first nationwide HPV vaccination campaign in February 2026, targeting 11.5 million adolescent girls to combat cervical cancer.
just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora families can help counter vaccine hesitancy among relatives in India and should be aware that HPV vaccination is now freely available at government facilities for 14-year-old girls nationwide.

just_in.title: Diana Edulji Calls for Harmanpreet Kaur's Removal as T20I Captain After World Cup Exit
just_in.excerpt: Former India captain and ICC Hall of Famer says Harmanpreet has 'stagnated' and demands bold leadership changes after a second consecutive group-stage elimination at the Women's T20 World Cup.
just_in.image_caption: Harmanpreet Kaur holds the 2025 Women's Cricket World Cup trophy in New Delhi. Her captaincy in the T20I format is now under scrutiny after India's second successive group-stage exit at the T20 World Cup in England.
just_in.nri_angle: The captaincy debate resonates with the diaspora, especially fans in England who watched the World Cup live and those following the team's rising global profile through the WPL and ODI World Cup triumph.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Thailand Restores Visa-Free Entry for India in Revised 30-Day Framework
just_in.excerpt: After a brief scare that left Indian travellers uncertain, Thailand's cabinet has added India to its revised 30-day visa exemption list alongside Croatia, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Malta and the Maldives.
just_in.image_caption: A temple in Thailand, one of the most popular tourism destinations in Southeast Asia. The Thai government has restored visa-free entry for Indian travellers under a revised 30-day framework approved on July 14, 2026.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian travellers, who form Thailand's third-largest visitor market, retain hassle-free visa-free access for tourism stays of up to 30 days under the revised framework.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: RBI Swap Facility Draws $20.7 Billion in Forex Inflows as FCNR Deposits Surge
just_in.excerpt: The central bank's concessional swap window has attracted $17.4 billion in FCNR(B) deposits alone since June, though early mobilisation trails initial market estimates of $50-70 billion.
just_in.image_caption: Indian currency notes representing the foreign exchange inflows attracted through the RBI's concessional swap facility. The central bank reported USD 20.72 billion in total forex inflows through the scheme as of July 17, 2026.
just_in.nri_angle: NRIs, especially in the Gulf, can earn 6-7.1% on dollar deposits with no currency risk and tax-free interest in India, with leverage options amplifying returns for high-net-worth depositors.

just_in.title: India's Oil Import Bill Surges as Iran War Sends Crude Prices Past $90
just_in.excerpt: Brent crude hit a five-week high of $90.75 per barrel on Monday as renewed fighting choked the Strait of Hormuz, piling fresh pressure on India's already ballooning energy import costs and weakening rupee.
just_in.image_caption: An oil tanker at sea. India's crude oil import bill has surged as the U.S.-Iran conflict chokes shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, forcing refiners to seek costlier alternative supply routes.
just_in.nri_angle: Rising oil prices are eroding the value of rupee-denominated savings for NRIs and inflating everyday costs for Indian households through fuel and food price hikes.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Odisha's ₹8,300 Crore Coastal Highway to Slash Travel Time to Puri and Konark
just_in.excerpt: India's cabinet has approved a 160-km highway along Odisha's coast that will cut travel time by 2.5 hours and accelerate a tourism boom already drawing millions to the state's temples and beaches.
just_in.image_caption: The Konark Sun Temple in Odisha, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that draws millions of visitors annually. A new ₹8,300 crore coastal highway approved by India's cabinet will dramatically improve road access to Konark, Puri, and other coastal destinations.
just_in.nri_angle: The highway and planned Puri International Airport will make Odisha's temple and coastal circuit far more accessible for NRI pilgrims and heritage travellers with limited vacation time.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Messi Faces Backlash for Trying to Get Cucurella Sent Off in World Cup Final
just_in.excerpt: Argentina captain Lionel Messi drew widespread criticism after attempting to exploit FIFA's mouth-covering rule to get Spain's Marc Cucurella red-carded during the 2026 World Cup final, which Spain won 1-0 in extra time.
just_in.image_caption: Lionel Messi in action for Argentina during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The 39-year-old captain drew sharp criticism for trying to get Spain's Marc Cucurella sent off in the final.
just_in.nri_angle: The incident sours the final World Cup memory for millions of Indian football fans who have idolised Messi for over two decades.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indian IT Giants Shift Spending to AI and BFSI as Macro Headwinds Stall Broader Growth
just_in.excerpt: With discretionary budgets frozen and overall revenue growth stuck at 3-4%, India's Big Five IT firms are channelling investment into AI-led transformation, banking modernisation and cybersecurity — the few pockets where client spending still flows.
just_in.image_caption: IT professionals at work in a technology services office. India's $315 billion IT sector is navigating a spending shift towards AI and banking modernisation as discretionary budgets remain frozen amid macro uncertainty.
just_in.nri_angle: The shift towards AI, data engineering and cybersecurity skills directly affects career prospects for millions of Indian IT professionals both in India and across the diaspora, particularly in the US and UK.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: U.S. Ends Duration of Status for Student Visas: What Employers Need to Know
just_in.excerpt: A new DHS rule replaces open-ended stays with fixed four-year admission periods for F-1, J-1, and I visa holders, creating new compliance burdens for employers before the September 15 deadline.
just_in.image_caption: International students walk across a U.S. university campus. A new DHS rule ending duration of status will impose fixed four-year admission caps on F-1, J-1, and I visa holders starting September 15, 2026.
just_in.nri_angle: India sends the most international students to the U.S. and the government has raised concerns about the new rule's impact on Indian students and professionals.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: How a Top Cleric’s Fatwa Could Complicate Pakistan’s Crypto Ambitions
just_in.excerpt: Mufti Taqi Usmani’s ruling that cryptocurrency is not wealth under Islamic law threatens Islamabad’s push to regulate digital assets and its “crypto diplomacy” with the Trump family’s World Liberty Financial.
just_in.image_caption: Mufti Muhammad Taqi Usmani, photographed in London in 2016. The influential Pakistani Islamic scholar issued a fatwa in June 2026 declaring cryptocurrency transactions impermissible under Shariah law.
just_in.nri_angle: Usmani's rulings are followed by Deobandi institutions in India and could influence Muslim crypto investors across South Asia and diaspora communities relying on digital remittance channels.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Shamita Shetty Opens Up About Endometriosis, Surgery, and the Two Years It Took to Lose 5 Kg
just_in.excerpt: On Soha Ali Khan's podcast, the actor described sudden weight gain, pain that woke her from sleep, and a diagnosis that came only after years of dismissed symptoms.
just_in.image_caption: Shamita Shetty at a public event. The actor recently spoke about her endometriosis diagnosis and recovery on Soha Ali Khan's podcast All About Her.
just_in.nri_angle: Endometriosis affects roughly 10 percent of women of reproductive age globally, yet stigma around discussing menstrual health persists in many South Asian communities, making public conversations like this particularly valuable for diaspora audiences.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Nico Williams Gives His World Cup Medal to His Mother, and the Backstory Will Move You
just_in.excerpt: The Spain winger who assisted the winning goal in Sunday's final repeated a gesture that first went viral at Euro 2024 — honoring the woman who crossed the Sahara barefoot to give him a future.
just_in.image_caption: Spain's Nico Williams during a national team match. The winger assisted the winning goal in the 2026 World Cup final and gave his winner's medal to his mother, Maria.
just_in.nri_angle: Williams's story — of immigrant parents who sacrificed everything for a better life — resonates deeply with the Indian diaspora, many of whom made similar journeys to build lives abroad.

just_in.title: Marvel Drops First Avengers: Doomsday Trailer as Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom Takes Center Stage
just_in.excerpt: The trailer features Doctor Doom battling Thor, the return of Chris Evans as Captain America, and a massive ensemble cast spanning the MCU, X-Men, and Fantastic Four.
just_in.image_caption: Robert Downey Jr. at a previous San Diego Comic-Con. The actor returns to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as the villain Doctor Doom in Avengers: Doomsday.
just_in.image_credit: Wikimedia Commons / Gage Skidmore / CC BY-SA 2.0
just_in.nri_angle: Marvel films consistently rank among the top-grossing franchises in India, with Avengers: Endgame still holding the record for highest Hollywood opening weekend in the country.

news.excerpt: Iran has launched missile strikes on US military installations across Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait and Qatar, killing at least three American soldiers, as a senior adviser warns of imminent full-scale offensive operations.
news.image_caption: Satellite image of the Strait of Hormuz between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula. The IRGC has warned the strategic waterway will not be safe for oil tankers as the US-Iran conflict enters its ninth consecutive day of strikes.

news.title: Iran Orders Houthis to Prepare Red Sea Blockade Threatening Saudi Oil Routes
news.excerpt: Tehran has instructed Yemen's Houthis to stand ready to close the Bab el-Mandeb Strait if the US strikes Iranian power infrastructure, deploying missiles and drones near the critical shipping chokepoint.
news.image_caption: Satellite view of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the narrow waterway connecting the Gulf of Aden to the Red Sea between Yemen and the Horn of Africa. Iran has instructed Houthi forces to prepare to block this critical shipping route.
news.nri_angle: Red Sea shipping disruption threatens Indian trade routes through the Suez corridor and endangers millions of NRI workers in Gulf states facing missile strikes.

news.title: Delhi High Court Questions Police Over Surveillance of CJP Protesters at Jantar Mantar
news.excerpt: A PIL alleges Delhi Police installed a permanent surveillance tower and indiscriminately filmed protesters — including women in wet clothing — without legal authority, in what the petition calls a violation of constitutional privacy rights.
news.image_caption: Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, site of the ongoing CJP sit-in and hunger strike since June 20. A PIL filed in the Delhi High Court alleges police installed a permanent surveillance tower at the protest site.
news.nri_angle: The PIL raises questions about protest surveillance and privacy rights in India that resonate with diaspora members who follow Indian civil liberties debates and the CJP movement's anti-corruption demands.

news.title: India's Cockroach Movement Wins First Government Meeting After Tear Gas and Baton Charges Near Parliament
news.excerpt: Health Minister JP Nadda agreed to meet CJP leaders as police fired tear gas at 10,000 protesters marching on Parliament during the Monsoon session's opening day.
news.image_caption: Activist Sonam Wangchuk, whose forced hospitalisation on Saturday galvanised the Cockroach Janta Party movement. The government agreed to its first direct talks with CJP leaders on Monday after police fired tear gas at protesters near Parliament.
news.nri_angle: The NEET exam leaks resonate with NRI families whose children face India's competitive entrance exam system.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Tripura Police Chief Anurag Dhankar Found Dead at State Headquarters in Suspected Suicide
news.excerpt: The 1994-batch IPS officer, who led the Nirav Modi PNB scam investigation at the CBI, was found dead at the Agartala police headquarters on Monday. Chief Minister Manik Saha rushed to the scene.
news.image_caption: Indian police officers on duty. Tripura DGP Anurag Dhankar, a 1994-batch IPS officer, was found dead at the Agartala police headquarters on Monday.
news.nri_angle: High-profile death of senior IPS officer who investigated international financial crimes raises concerns about institutional pressures in India's law enforcement.

news.title: Andy Burnham Becomes UK Prime Minister as Starmer Steps Down After Two Years
news.excerpt: The former Mayor of Greater Manchester takes office as Britain's seventh PM in a decade, pledging to 'rewire' the nation amid economic headwinds and rising Reform threat.
news.image_caption: Andy Burnham delivers his first speech outside 10 Downing Street after being appointed UK prime minister. Burnham pledged to rewire Britain's political and economic system.
news.image_credit: Chris McAndrew / UK Parliament, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
news.nri_angle: UK leadership change affects immigration, trade, and economic policies for Britain's 1.8 million-strong Indian-origin community.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Supreme Court Orders New SIT to Probe Ram Mandir Donation Theft as Scandal Deepens
news.excerpt: Chief Justice Surya Kant directs that a senior IPS officer lead the reconstituted investigation team, saying the probe must be fair and unbiased. The case returns to court on July 27.
news.image_caption: The Ram Mandir in Ayodhya, India, inaugurated in January 2024. The Supreme Court ordered a fresh investigation into alleged theft of donations at the temple.
news.nri_angle: Ram Mandir holds deep emotional significance for global Hindu diaspora; many contributed donations and are concerned about alleged misappropriation.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Telugu Student Anurup Reddy Drowns Saving Three Friends at Texas Reservoir
news.excerpt: The 22-year-old University of North Texas graduate rescued three friends from the Toledo Bend Reservoir spillway before a submerged fishing line trapped him underwater.
news.image_caption: Toledo Bend Reservoir on the Texas-Louisiana border, where 22-year-old Anurup Reddy Koduru drowned on May 29 after rescuing three friends. Emergency teams recovered his body from a depth of 20 feet.
news.nri_angle: A recent Telugu graduate's death while saving friends highlights the recurring pattern of Indian student fatalities abroad and the diaspora community's grief and fundraising response.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: DMK MLA GV Markandeyan Arrested Over Threatening Remarks Against Tamil Nadu CM Vijay
news.excerpt: The Vilathikulam legislator was detained by police after allegedly making threatening and controversial remarks against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at a public meeting in Kovilpatti, marking the second arrest of a DMK MLA over anti-Vijay remarks in recent weeks.
news.image_caption: A political demonstration in India. DMK MLA GV Markandeyan was arrested in Tamil Nadu for remarks against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
news.nri_angle: The arrest deepens Tamil Nadu's ruling TVK-opposition DMK confrontation, a political fault line closely watched by the global Tamil diaspora with strong ties to Dravidian party politics.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Student Loan Defaults Surge Past 9 Million as Post-Pandemic Repayment Crisis Deepens
news.excerpt: Nearly 3.6 million Americans defaulted on federal student loans in just six months. With wage garnishments resuming and the SAVE plan dead, millions more face a ticking clock.
news.image_caption: Federal student loan borrowers face mounting pressure as default numbers reach historic highs following the end of pandemic-era payment protections. The Department of Education reported 9.57 million borrowers in default as of March 2026.
news.nri_angle: Indian Americans with federal student loans face the same default risks and wage garnishment enforcement, while Indian students on F-1 visas managing private education loans are fast-tracking repayments amid visa and employment uncertainties.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian Seafarers Among Dead as Russian Missile Strikes Grain Ship Off Ukraine's Coast
news.excerpt: At least five crew members were killed when Russian forces hit a Guinea-Bissau-flagged corn cargo vessel in the Black Sea, with Indian and Syrian sailors among the 17-member international crew.
news.image_caption: A cargo vessel in the Black Sea. Russian forces struck a corn-laden ship carrying an international crew that included Indian and Syrian sailors, killing at least five.
news.nri_angle: Indian seafarers make up a significant share of the global merchant navy; this attack underscores the risks they face in active conflict zones critical to global food supply chains.

news.title: Police Cane Thousands of Cockroach Movement Supporters as 'Chalo Sansad' March Brings Delhi to a Standstill
news.excerpt: Around 10,000 protesters gathered at Jantar Mantar despite a police ban, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over the NEET paper leak scandal.
news.image_caption: Supporters of India's Cockroach Janta Party gather at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi for the 'Chalo Sansad' march. Police deployed lathi charges and heavy barricades as thousands defied a ban on the protest.
news.nri_angle: India's largest youth-led protest in years highlights systemic failures in education that affect millions of families, including those with children in the diaspora considering Indian competitive exams.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Pakistan Summons Imran Khan's Sister After Remarks on Army's Inability to Defeat India
news.excerpt: Aleema Khan faces fresh legal action over controversial statements questioning Pakistan's military performance during the 2025 conflict with India and her praise of Prime Minister Modi's leadership.
news.image_caption: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan addressing a forum during his time in office. His sister Aleema Khan now faces legal summons for remarks criticizing the Pakistan Army's performance during the 2025 conflict with India.
news.nri_angle: Aleema Khan's acknowledgment of India's military superiority and praise for Modi from within a prominent Pakistani political family underscores shifting power dynamics that resonate with the Indian diaspora.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Tulsi Gabbard's Brother Charged With Trying to Lure Children at Waikiki Hotel
news.excerpt: Batarti Gabbard, 55, was arrested on custodial interference charges after allegedly offering children gum and money to accompany him to his hotel room. His family says he is in the grip of a mental health crisis.
news.image_caption: Tulsi Gabbard in her official portrait as Director of National Intelligence. Her older brother, Batarti Gabbard, has been charged with custodial interference after allegedly approaching children at a Waikiki hotel pool.
news.nri_angle: Tulsi Gabbard, the first Hindu elected to U.S. Congress, holds particular significance for the Indian-American community; the arrest of her brother adds a personal crisis to a politically prominent family with deep Hindu roots.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Indian Pilots Urge Government to Suspend All UAE Flights Amid Gulf Crisis
news.excerpt: The Airline Pilots' Association of India has demanded the DGCA halt commercial flights to the UAE and other high-risk Gulf airspace, calling continued operations 'wilful endangerment' as EASA warns of missile and drone threats through July 29.
news.image_caption: Two pilots navigate a commercial aircraft cockpit during flight. India's largest pilot association has demanded the government suspend all flights to the UAE and Gulf conflict zones as US-Iran military exchanges intensify.
news.nri_angle: An estimated 3.5 million Indian nationals in the UAE face travel uncertainty as Indian pilots demand flight suspensions and over 15,000 Indian seafarers remain stranded near the Strait of Hormuz.

news.title: Taiwan Reports 83% Surge in Chinese Vessel Activity Near Island
news.excerpt: Coast guard data shows 55 Chinese government vessel sightings around Taiwan in June, up from 30 in May, as Taipei plans drills to counter potential blockade of Pacific supply routes.
news.image_caption: A coast guard vessel patrols open waters. Taiwan reported 55 Chinese government vessel sightings around the island in June 2026, an 83% increase from the previous month.
news.nri_angle: A potential Taiwan blockade could disrupt semiconductor exports and supply chains critical to India's economy, with Taiwanese firms like Powerchip already partnering with Tata Group on India's first chip fab in Gujarat.

nri-world.title: Indian-American Hanu Karlapalem Wins National STEM Endorsement for Alabama House Race
nri-world.excerpt: The technology entrepreneur and naturalized U.S. citizen is challenging a two-term Republican incumbent in North Alabama while fighting a state bill that would bar immigrants from public office.
nri-world.image_caption: The Alabama State Capitol in Montgomery. Hanu Karlapalem is seeking to represent District 4 in the Alabama House of Representatives.
nri-world.nri_angle: Karlapalem’s candidacy reflects the growing political engagement of Indian-Americans across the U.S. His fight against SB21, which would bar naturalized citizens from office, resonates with the broader immigrant community.

nri-world.title: Keir Starmer Leaves Downing Street as Andy Burnham Becomes Britain's New PM
nri-world.excerpt: The outgoing PM departed with an emotional farewell after two turbulent years, leaving behind a complicated legacy with Britain's Indian community — from his love of Indian cuisine to the Diwali controversy.
nri-world.image_caption: Keir Starmer in his official portrait as Prime Minister. He formally departed Downing Street on Monday after two years in office, making way for Andy Burnham.
nri-world.nri_angle: The transition raises questions for Britain's 1.8 million-strong Indian community about hospitality VAT relief, trade policy with India, and cultural engagement under the new PM.

nri-world.title: Indian Students Abroad Face Deadly Crisis: 26 Killed in Violent Attacks, Deportations Surge
nri-world.excerpt: Parliamentary data reveals 26 Indian students killed in violent incidents in Canada and the US between 2018 and 2025, while deportations from America surged to 3,567 in 2025 and visa rejections hit record highs.
nri-world.image_caption: International students on a university campus. Indian students abroad face rising safety concerns amid a surge in violent incidents, deportations, and increasingly restrictive visa policies.
nri-world.nri_angle: Directly impacts the 1.33 million Indian students studying abroad and their families, who face escalating physical danger, record visa rejections, rising deportations, and new US regulations that could upend academic and career plans.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Four Indian Medical Students Injured in Neo-Nazi Knife Attack at Russian University
nri-world.excerpt: A 15-year-old linked to a banned extremist group stabbed four Indian students at Bashkir State Medical University in Ufa, prompting India's embassy to dispatch officials and AIMSA to appeal to PM Modi for stronger safety measures abroad.
nri-world.image_caption: Medical students in a university corridor. Four Indian medical students were injured in a knife attack at Bashkir State Medical University in Ufa, Russia.
nri-world.nri_angle: Four Indian medical students studying at a Russian university were directly targeted in a hate-motivated attack, raising urgent questions about the safety of the tens of thousands of Indian students enrolled in medical programs across Russia.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian Envoy Meets Distressed Women Workers in Oman, Pledges Quick Action
nri-world.excerpt: Ambassador Prashant Pise visited Indian women at the embassy's shelter in Muscat, hearing their complaints of abuse, wage theft and abandonment by employers.
nri-world.image_caption: An aerial view of Muscat, Oman's capital, where the Indian Embassy runs a shelter for distressed workers. India's ambassador met women domestic workers at the facility on Monday to hear their grievances.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian women from economically vulnerable backgrounds, often recruited through fraudulent agents, face exploitation as domestic workers in Gulf countries, highlighting the need for stronger protections for the diaspora's most vulnerable members.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Rajiv Meherish, Founder of Dubai's Raju Omlet Chain, Dies at His UAE Home
nri-world.excerpt: The Mumbai-born entrepreneur built a single-product egg restaurant into an eight-outlet chain studied by Harvard Business Review. He had lived in the UAE for over four decades.
nri-world.image_caption: An omelette dish of the kind served at Raju Omlet outlets across the UAE. Founder Rajiv Meherish built the chain from a single 18-seat restaurant in Dubai's Al Karama to eight locations before his death on July 19, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: Meherish's four-decade journey from Mumbai to Dubai epitomised the entrepreneurial arc of the Indian diaspora in the Gulf, building a brand that became a cultural touchstone for South Asian expatriates.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-Origin Student Vaibhav Bhaskar Sets Florida's Highest-Ever GPA at 11.99
nri-world.excerpt: The Steinbrenner High School valedictorian took 44 advanced courses, earned an associate degree, and is headed to Duke University — all while running a nonprofit for the homeless.
nri-world.image_caption: A student celebrates graduation day in cap and gown. Vaibhav Bhaskar graduated as valedictorian from Steinbrenner High School with an 11.99 weighted GPA.
nri-world.nri_angle: Indian-American student from a family with roots in Indian academia sets Florida state record for highest-ever high school GPA, adding to the pattern of Indian-origin students excelling in American education. His father, a Ph.D. chemist, represents the immigrant science professionals whose children are now charting their own paths in fields like finance.

nri-world.title: Parliament’s Monsoon Session Opens With Seven Bills and the Delimitation Question
nri-world.excerpt: The government has listed five new bills and two pending ones for the session running July 20 to August 13, but the politically explosive delimitation proposal remains conspicuously absent from the official agenda.
nri-world.image_caption: India’s new Parliament building in New Delhi, inaugurated in 2023. The Monsoon Session beginning July 20 will run for 19 sittings through August 13.
nri-world.nri_angle: The session’s legislative agenda — spanning taxation, foreign contribution regulation and potential delimitation — could reshape the policy landscape that NRIs navigate when engaging with India on property, investments and civic rights.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Diana Edulji Calls for Harmanpreet Kaur's Removal as T20I Captain After World Cup Exit
carousel.excerpt: Former India captain and ICC Hall of Famer says Harmanpreet has 'stagnated' and demands bold leadership changes after a second consecutive group-stage elimination at the Women's T20 World Cup.
carousel.image_caption: Harmanpreet Kaur holds the 2025 Women's Cricket World Cup trophy in New Delhi. Her captaincy in the T20I format is now under scrutiny after India's second successive group-stage exit at the T20 World Cup in England.
carousel.nri_angle: The captaincy debate resonates with the diaspora, especially fans in England who watched the World Cup live and those following the team's rising global profile through the WPL and ODI World Cup triumph.

carousel.title: Indian IT Giants Shift Spending to AI and BFSI as Macro Headwinds Stall Broader Growth
carousel.excerpt: With discretionary budgets frozen and overall revenue growth stuck at 3-4%, India's Big Five IT firms are channelling investment into AI-led transformation, banking modernisation and cybersecurity — the few pockets where client spending still flows.
carousel.image_caption: IT professionals at work in a technology services office. India's $315 billion IT sector is navigating a spending shift towards AI and banking modernisation as discretionary budgets remain frozen amid macro uncertainty.
carousel.nri_angle: The shift towards AI, data engineering and cybersecurity skills directly affects career prospects for millions of Indian IT professionals both in India and across the diaspora, particularly in the US and UK.

carousel.title: RBI Swap Facility Draws $20.7 Billion in Forex Inflows as FCNR Deposits Surge
carousel.excerpt: The central bank's concessional swap window has attracted $17.4 billion in FCNR(B) deposits alone since June, though early mobilisation trails initial market estimates of $50-70 billion.
carousel.image_caption: Indian currency notes representing the foreign exchange inflows attracted through the RBI's concessional swap facility. The central bank reported USD 20.72 billion in total forex inflows through the scheme as of July 17, 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs, especially in the Gulf, can earn 6-7.1% on dollar deposits with no currency risk and tax-free interest in India, with leverage options amplifying returns for high-net-worth depositors.
